title: Source V2 primary visual reading
description: One page transcribed directly from the original render by the executing agent, before any local OCR has run. This is the PRIMARY source candidate: local specialist readers are secondary witnesses that run afterwards on the same pixels and may corroborate or contradict it. Nothing here is verified; a human still decides every region against the original page. See docs/source-v2/DECISIONS.md D14.

image_sha256.description: Checksum of the rendered page the regions were measured from.

render_sha256.description: Checksum of the exact image that was looked at. Equal to image_sha256 for a whole-page reading; the crop checksum when a region was read from its crop.

provenance.description: Recorded so no later process can mistake this for OCR output.

bbox.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in rendered pixels, from the deterministic layout.

text.description: Exactly what is printed. Spelling as printed including apparent typos, X versus × as printed, punctuation, spacing, line breaks and blank lines preserved, URLs and spaced emails exactly as spaced, blank table cells left blank. Never corrected, inferred, translated, solved, normalised or filled in.

uncertainty.description: Every place the agent could not read the page with confidence. Empty means the whole region was legible.

status.description: A primary reading is never self-verifying. Only a human confirming against the original page creates Verified Source Content.
